name: Spanish Rice
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: ¼ cup fresh cilantro, finely chopped (optional)
½ cup shredded cooked chicken or pork
¼ cup minced chorizo, casing removed

steps: Melt butter in a large pot over medium high heat. Add onion, chiles, garlic, meats, and rice, and cook until chorizo and rice are golden brown.
Add broth and bay leaves. Bring to a boil and cook until liquid has evaporated and rice is tender.
Sprinkle with cilantro before serving, if desired.
